text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, have you seen this "Number"<n>magazine? It
did a feature on<n>Tracen's students.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Their paths to their dreams... as newly<n>born lights,
racing toward the future.<n>Just seeing them gets me
excited.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. If I made it in, you could read it<n>one day, far
into the future, and<n>reminisce about me, couldn't
you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No, but it wouldn't be just me. You'd<n>remember the
others too, as well as<n>all they saw, reflected in their
eyes. I<n>know you would.
